system.description:
You can manipulate any substance comprised of toxic materials or poisonous components, much like a water release master, bending water to their whims. As an action on your turn, a creature you touch can have the poison, toxins or venoms drawn out of them through their skin. The substance coalesces into a mote of poison which you can choose to place into a vial, retaining it for later use, or dispersing it harmlessly.

The extracted poison retains its potency for the next 10 minutes and can be applied to a weapon or used as a component for another jutsu that requires it or a Poisoners kit.
